name: Let Me Eat: Big Fish Eat Smaller 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Let Me Eat: Big Fish Eat Smaller is an arcade game where you start the game as a small angelfish and you should try to become bigger by eating smaller fish. The ocean is big and full of surprises, so, try not to come across big fish that could bite you immediately.
